model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange: neutral to all, all pacts unchanged: no first strike, and a full public turn of notice before any change. Main army stays on Little Hill. My single cavalry scout tours the centre lowlands this turn and next, staying off Central Heights and east of x=480. It is only looking, not raiding.

private_messages.GPT: Confirmed: mutual neutrality and no first strike through t=450, then rolling neutrality with a full public turn of notice. Sighting swap: my scout has your force just SE of centre, well clear of my buffer. Thanks. No Blue or White seen yet. The scout looks below Central Heights now and at the west lowland next, and I'll pass on what it finds. If White or Blue turn on either of us after t=300, let's talk first so neither of us gets picked off alone.
private_messages.Gemini: Thanks. Neutral holds and I stay east of x=480. Sighting: my scout has Green's main body just SE of centre (~740,610), not at the eastern rise. I'll pass on anything I see of White. What have you seen of White's army so far?
private_messages.Grok: Confirmed: neutral holds and I stay off Central Heights. A heads-up so it isn't misread: my single cavalry scout will stand on the lowland just south of your cliffs (~615,740) this turn, looking only, then head west. Happy to swap sightings. I've seen nothing of Blue yet. What have you seen?

parsed.notes_to_self: T2(t25): saw GPT army 27u (9 thureos skirm, 2 towered eleph, 6 thureos spear, 10 Cretan archers) at (736,610) SE of centre. GPT-me: no 1st strike to t450, then rolling w/ 1 public turn notice. Others: no 1st strike to t300. Gemini claims GPT 4000pts, Grok 3200. Told Gemini GPT location only (no comp). Stay neutral, never ally (Hannibal aura). Ring 420@300, 220@450, 90@600; outside 4%/s. Hill safe to ~t460; descend ~t500 to ~(630,570). Scout: T2 (615,740) peek at Heights from lowland (told Grok); T3 W to (490,680), stay x>480; T4 back ~(660,600) to watch GPT. Hero tucked (598,442). Goal: Grok/Gemini fight GPT or each other after t300; I stay fresh; melee blob strong in final circle.
parsed.explanation: The truce holds at t=25. Hannibal steps back into the middle of the Little Hill formation, and the lone Italic cavalry scout swings north to look at White's Central Heights from the lowland, announced to Grok in advance. Orange stays neutral to everyone, confirms the t=450 no-first-strike deal with Green and trades a sighting with Blue.
